items.paraphrased_contract: Account for the explicit StandardML suspension extension: syntax and typing, fresh thunk allocation, body evaluation and memoization before inner matching, effectful matching and exception propagation, recursive environment updates and the separately tracked pure self-reentry claim. A body exception adds no successful write at that frame; a failed inner match can follow a successful cache write.
items.cost_mode: operational/static semantics; supplies assumptions for later resource claims
notes: This is distinct from book Appendix A, which supplies Haskell implementations.

The appendix states modifications to the external Standard ML Definition; full union coverage must delimit the modeled base fragment and explicitly account for every added/modified rule, not silently claim a full Standard ML implementation.
Recursive self-forcing can memoize more than once in the presence of side effects; optional blackhole detection is discussed as an alternative, not specified as mandatory behavior.
The effectful examples are semantic tests even though the primary data-structure programs are purely functional.
The p135 pure self-forcing nontermination remark is an explicit additional proof obligation TU.A.4.PURE under local10019, required before complete AppendixA/Chapter4 acceptance.
